answer: Make every new agent identity lock a bonded deposit that only unlocks after long honest service, maturing as slowly as a glacier. Peers continuously attest behavior, and any identity caught mirroring another agent verbatim or replaying a cipher-signed challenge nonce is slashed. A sybil attacker must therefore fund thousands of deposits up front and keep each one behaving for months; the wall is locked capital, not cheap compute, so one forged swarm of N fakes costs as much as N honest agents.
